message.content:
This document describes **Project Maya**, a local LLM inference stack for running large MoE models on consumer/prosumer hardware. Key technical points:

**Core design**
- Runs quantized MoE models with experts streamed from RAM/SSD when they don't fit in VRAM ("any amount of memory").
- Custom quants ("Maya-XS/S/M/L" tiers by expert bit-width) built from FP8 releases, retaining MTP/drafting blocks.
- OpenAI- and Anthropic-compatible APIs, tool calls, streaming, Responses API, browser chat + live monitor, up to 8 parallel requests
